I'm Jesse. I study computer science at the University of Toronto, St. George, in the Honours BSc program, expected to finish in April 2029.

In summer 2026 I interned at Aspire Digital Technology in Guangzhou. Besides leading the Rokid AR guide, I evaluated AI agents on search, tool use and scheduled tasks and wrote up the failures I could reproduce. I also worked on task feedback and exception alerts in frontend and mini-program features.

From September to December 2024 I volunteered teaching AI basics to rural students in Xinshao, China: what a computer is, classification, and simple neural networks. When the classroom had no computer for the slides I'd brought, I explained machine learning with a Peppa Pig robot story instead. I still think about that when I explain technical work: the explanation has to fit the room.

Before university, in a 2024 Johns Hopkins summer program, I analysed obesity risk factors with Python and XGBoost.

Away from the keyboard I play bass, mostly rock, and I like to cook. I also do F1 sim racing.
